description: Adds a note to the planning pass that is running, for the next pass to read (journal_read): what you are waiting for, what to check, what you decided not to do and why. Only a weekly or daily pass keeps one: from the chat or the owner's AI no pass is running, so nothing is kept (ok false); a fact goes in owner_fact_set, something learned in learning_write. It needs an act key.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
